fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) rose +33.2% over past year (semiconductor sector +6.8%); Q3 2026 revenue $46.72bn (+41.2% YoY), net income +68.7% surge
fields.summary_ko.1: High-performance computing (HPC) revenue increased 22% sequentially to represent 68% of total revenue (vs. 57% prior year); 2-nanometer technology represented 8% of wafer revenue; 2026–2028 capex expected to significantly exceed prior 3-year run rate
